title: ResQCare-MCI: A prospective, exploratory study evaluating the questionnaire on caregiver resilience and burden in relatives of people living with prodromal syndrome
summary:
The aim of this study is to investigate whether particularly vulnerable caregivers and people living with prodromal dementia syndrome could be identidied by using an easily applicable questionnaire (ResQCare-MCI).
The ResQCare-MCI is a linguistically adapted version of the previously developed questionnaire on informal caregiver resilience and burden (ResQCare) and was developed for relatives of people with prodromal dementia syndrome. The term prodromal refers to the presence of disease-related cognitive impairment and behavioral changes, which are not severe enough to be diagnosed as dementia. 
We would like to investigate whether the clinical characteristics of people living with prodromal syndrome (such as cognitive performance, illness awareness and behavioral symptoms, cortisol as a biopsychological measure of stress experience) are related to the burden on caregivers and whether the ResQCare-MCI is a reliable measure for estimating this burden. By conducting a second measurement after 6 months, we would like to examine whether the questionnaire can also be used to assess the progression of burden.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Person living with prodromal syndrome: 
- Prodromal syndrome in the assessment of everyday activity according to a Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR = 0.5)
- adequate German language skills
- GDS-15 < 5 and clinically no relevant depressive syndrome 
- Relatives present
- No current inpatient stay and not living in a nursing home

Informal caregiver:
- highest degree of availability to the person with prodromal syndrome compared to other caregivers
- Living in the same household as the person with prodromal syndrome
- adequate German language skills
Exclusion criteria:
Person living with prodromal syndrom: 
- No below-average cognitive performance in one or more cognitive domains (SD ≤ 1 from the mean of the age- and education-adjusted norm)
- [for hair sampling: Use of cortisone preparations (cortisol, hydrocortisone and cortisone)]

Informal caregiver:
- Known current diagnosis of depression / current psychiatric and/or psychotherapeutic treatment / severe depression symptoms in QIDS-SR16 survey ≥ 16 points
- Psychotic syndrome in the context of internal or psychiatric illnesses 
- [for hair sampling: Use of cortisone preparations (cortisol, hydrocortisone and cortisone)]
